text:
alex chen: quick ping — PR #4982 updates the KV prefetch window and a tiny attention-kernel tweak. Fixes a double-prefetch race for short sequences. looking for 1 reviewer + approval to merge into canary today. patch is small (2 files).

drew: on it. will scan for locking/race stuff. do you have a microbenchmark or perf numbers?

alex chen: added a unit test and a microbench: `tests/kv/prefetch_test.py` and `tools/bench/kvmicro`. baseline shows no p50 regression, ~0.6% improvement at p95 for short seqs.

priya k: PTAL in ~30m; if CI is green and no SLO hits I'll approve. can you paste the specific guard change?

alex chen: sure — changed the prefetch fast-path to check `if (!kv_prefetch_inflight(ctx)) { start_prefetch(); }` and added a `prefetch_inflight` counter + metric. also tightened a small branch in the attn tile to avoid extra memcpy for len<=32.

ci-bot: Build results for PR #4982 — CI passed ✅ (3/3). Integration tests ok.

elaine: quick heads-up — last canary run showed a small drop in prefix cache hit-rate for very short sequences; watch the telemetry after this goes to canary.

drew: left 2 minor comments inline (locking comment and a log level nit). otherwise LGTM.

alex chen: pushed fix for the locking nit and lowered the log. Thanks @drew. cc @priya k

priya k: approving now. would like a note in rollout docs about the prefetch TTL assumption, then merge.

alex chen: running canary deploy: `/deploy canary --pr 4982` — i'll report back in ~10m.

ci-bot: Canary deploy started for PR #4982 — https://deploys.internal/reports/4982

alex chen: canary looks clean so far (no error spikes, latency stable). merging in 5.

drew: thanks. please add an item to the runtime-rollouts doc about the KV TTL assumption so support knows to watch it.

alex chen: will update runtime-rollouts.md and add the metric name `kv.prefetch.inflight` to the alerting dashboard. :thumbsup:

alex chen: merged. closing the loop here — thanks everyone for quick reviews!
